gloss: closing time (of a shop or restaurant)

definitions.gloss: closing time; the time at which a shop, restaurant, or other business closes for the day
definitions.explanation: The time at which a retail shop, restaurant, or similar business stops operating for the day. Posted on shop signs and websites, and commonly discussed when planning visits.

examples.japanese: {閉店時間|へいてんじかん}は{何時|なんじ}ですか。
{閉店時間|へいてんじかん}が{近|ちか}づいたので{急|いそ}いで{会計|かいけい}を{済|す}ませた。
examples.english: Closing time was approaching, so I hurried to pay the bill.

examples.japanese: このレストランは{平日|へいじつ}と{週末|しゅうまつ}で{閉店時間|へいてんじかん}が{違|ちが}うので{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: Please note that this restaurant's closing time is different on weekdays and weekends.

notes:
Composed of {閉店|へいてん} (closing of a shop) and {時間|じかん} (time). Used for the closing time of retail establishments — shops, restaurants, cafes, banks, and similar businesses that have daily opening and closing hours.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閉店時間|へいてんじかん}が{近|ちか}づく: closing time approaches
- {閉店時間|へいてんじかん}{間際|まぎわ}: right before closing time
- {閉店時間|へいてんじかん}を{過|す}ぎる: to go past closing time
- {閉店時間|へいてんじかん}を{延長|えんちょう}する: to extend closing time
- {閉店時間|へいてんじかん}は{午後|ごご}9{時|じ}: the closing time is 9 PM

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {開店時間|かいてんじかん}: opening time — the antonym
- {営業時間|えいぎょうじかん}: business hours — covers the whole range from opening to closing
- {閉館|へいかん}{時間|じかん}: closing time of a museum, library, or other public facility (not a shop)
- {終業|しゅうぎょう}{時間|じかん}: end-of-work time — for offices/workplaces, not for shops serving customers
